data.description:
## Goal
Audit every call site that reads completion-verifier output and document which field they read (overall_verdict vs P1). Produce the migration map needed for T3.

## Audit Steps
grep -r 'overall_verdict\|completion.verifier\|verifier.*verdict' plugins/dso/ --include='*.md' --include='*.sh' -l

## Files to Identify
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (Phase G verifier verdict read)
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md (any verifier reads)
- plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md (story closure verifier reads)
- Any other .sh or .md files reading verifier JSON

## Output
Add a ticket comment with the migration map: {file, line_pattern, current_field, target_field}

## Acceptance Criteria
- .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment 797f-39ed-6475-4cd9 containing MIGRATION_MAP: with JSON list of caller locations
- Caller count matches grep count above (no files missed)

## Testing Mode
GREEN (audit task — no new code; depends S1 tasks complete)
data.title: T1: GREEN — Audit all completion-verifier consumers and document migration map
